label: MutateIn (sub-document write) Advanced Accessor
type: the Advanced Keyspace Accessor form of sub-document write (insert/replace/remove/arrayAppend on a specific path) without rewriting the whole document. CAS-free, unlike the whole-document write accessors. Sibling of eventing:lookupin-operation.
aliases_note: Same genre-fork fold as lookupin-operation: eventing:mutatein-operation (overview page) + eventing:mutatein-subdocument-operation (this round's mint, from the advancedMutateInField/advancedMutateInArray demonstration pages), zero file overlap.
evidence: couchbase.mutateIn(binding, meta, spec) - Performs one or more sub-document mutations (insert, replace, remove, arrayAppend) on a document.
note: arrayAppend is documented safe under 18 concurrent workers with no CAS coordination required - a concurrency-safety property this registry has no predicate for yet.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a handler append to an array field inside a document concurrently, without a CAS retry loop?
